description: List MCP integrations in the organization. Returns paginated integration records plus total and has_more for discovering integration IDs; use get_mcp_integration for one integration's full Portkey-side config and list_mcp_servers for the servers under an integration.

current_page.description: Zero-based page number; the first page is 0

type.description: Filter by workspace, organisation, or all integration ownership

name: list_mcp_integrations

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
